title: Day 716 — Sheinbaum Previews Sept 19 National Earthquake Drill, Announces Route 57 Highway Extension to US Border
detail: On September 17, 2026 (Day 716, Thursday), President Sheinbaum held her mañanera in the National Palace's Salón Tesorería, previewing the Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026, scheduled for Saturday, September 19 at 12:00 noon local time across all 32 states — a date chosen to mark the anniversaries of the 1985 and 2017 earthquakes. She confirmed the drill would use the same seismic-alert tone as a real earthquake, broadcast via cellphone alerts and roughly 23,000 loudspeakers concentrated in Pacific-coast and central states. Separately, the director of Banobras presented the administration's public-private highway program of 19 projects, including extending Federal Highway 57 — which currently links Mexico City through Querétaro, San Luis Potosí and Saltillo — northward to the US border, financed without straining public finances. Sheinbaum also addressed a survey on foreign intervention in Mexico and a US report on drug trafficking, and discussed women's political participation.

media.caption: Sheinbaum previews the September 19 national earthquake drill and the Route 57 highway extension at her September 17 mañanera
